warnings: S1's exact function is not labelled on this sheet beyond the shape/rebar — see plan_beam_floor1 (หน้า21) file's warning for where it appears in plan.

'รูปตัด 1-1 แสดงเสา CS1-อกไก่' confirms the roof is asymmetric (mono-pitch-like): CS1 sits at the ridge ('อกไก่') with BS1/rafters sloping down on both sides at different rates — dimensions of the slope itself are not printed as numbers on this cropped view (only member sizes/spacing, already captured in plan_beam_roof_frame and plan_beam_roof_edge), so no additional z_levels entry was derivable from it.

BX has two separate rebar views on this sheet: the sloped elevation shows '3Ø16มม' running along the incline (top face) and '2Ø16มม' at the flat bottom-end cross-section (which also repeats '2Ø16มม' at top), plus a diagonal bar callout '1Ø16มม ล้วงเข้าคาน B1,B3 ไม่น้อยกว่า 1 ม.' (1-Ø16mm lapping into beam B1/B3, not less than 1.00m — a lap-splice detail per schema §7). The 3Ø16 (elevation) and 2Ø16 top/2Ø16 bottom (end section) were not fully reconciled into one consistent main_bar reading — recorded main_bar as the end-section's symmetric 2Ø16/2Ø16 and kept the elevation's 3Ø16 as an additional_bars entry rather than silently picking one over the other.
